ValidationRule.description: Booked date cannot be before today's date unless changed by SysAdmin or SuperUser. CloseDate formerly First Bill Date, Booked Date is now First Bill Date. #20656- Removed the Profiles, to make it applicable for all except Admins
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND (
ISCHANGED(CloseDate), CloseDate < TODAY (), NOT( $Permission.Bypass_Stage_5_VR ), NOT($Permission.VR_Bypass_Permission),
NOT($Permission.Edit_Close_Date_in_Late_Stage_Opp), $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', $Profile.Name <> 'IM_Custom Sys Admin'
)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Your Opportunity's Closed Date cannot be a past date. Update to an appropriate date in order to proceed. Need help? Contact your Sales Operations Business Partner.
